ask: Is it fine to tell the picture check that Arabic names sit at the right?
problem: The nightly English tutorial job fails on some nights and passes on others. Nothing is wrong with the app.
found: All 46 films played. The picture check, an AI, held one film. It called the Arabic name in the language list misplaced. Arabic starts at the right, so the check was wrong, not the app or scripts. It fails only on nights this film is shot again.
changed: The picture check now has a note: names in right-to-left writing start at the right of their row, and that is correct. People see no change in the app or the videos.
why: Only the check was wrong. Changing the app would make the list worse, and a film script cannot move the name. Tests did not run here; the pull request checks will run them.
touches: Nothing else. No video was published or changed on YouTube. Other checks stay as they were.
